summary: First-run full-stack testing of Orby. Backend: 18/18 pytest passing (chat, local intents hora/relógio, email/agenda/timer action generation, TTS endpoint + mp3 streaming, vision with real JPEG, voice-turn with/without wake word + require_wake=0 bypass, history/memories CRUD + cleanup). Frontend web preview (390x844): main screen, robot-face, status-chip, all 5 bottom-bar testIDs (mic/live/sound/type/settings), caption-text render; HUD clock panel (hud-panel, hud-clock-time, hud-battery) toggles on status-chip tap; type-message flow sends text, caption updates, hud-summary (hud-summary-title + hud-summary-text) appears on the left with face shifted right; settings-sheet opens with voice chips, pause chips, switches; settings-history-button opens history-sheet showing user+orby messages; gemini-live-panel opens showing camera permission prompt (expected on headless web — camera unavailable).
action_items: No functional fixes required — all backend endpoints and frontend testIDs behave as specified.

(Observation only, no action) After tapping hud-close-button the panel disappears visually immediately, but the hud-summary-title element remains briefly in the DOM due to the react-native-reanimated FadeOut exit animation. UX is correct; if automated tests want to assert absence, they should check visibility/opacity rather than DOM existence.
Face tracking (VisionCamera+MLKit) and continuous mic listening on web are platform-limited; this is by design and not testable here.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly uses /api prefix, env-only config (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY), excludes mongo _id via to_mongo helper, validates with Pydantic, and uses async motor correctly.
TTS cache keyed by sha256 of (text|voice|model|format|instructions) with graceful fallback to tts-1 and 45s timeout — good.
voice-turn correctly returns {woke:false,reason:'no_wake'|'too_short'|'empty'} without calling Gemini when wake word is required and missing.
Frontend: process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL used, all interactive elements expose testIDs, mongo _id never surfaces in /api/history or /api/memories responses.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows (face-tracking + continuous mic are native-only, out of scope on web)

seed_data_creation: Tests create and then clean up session TEST_orby_<uuid>; final test_clear_history_and_memories wipes session data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_orby_backend.py (runs ~40s with pytest-xdist on 2 workers). Requires Pillow (installed). All frontend testIDs confirmed: orby-screen, robot-face, status-chip, status-text, mic-button, gemini-live-button, sound-toggle-button, type-message-button, settings-button, caption-text, hud-panel, hud-clock-time, hud-battery, type-message-input, type-message-send-button, hud-summary-title, hud-summary-text, hud-close-button, settings-sheet, settings-history-button, history-sheet, history-item-user, history-item-orby, gemini-live-panel, gemini-live-allow-camera-button. Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env (also in /app/frontend/.env).
